steps.name: Timing
steps.what: What notes when each word is spoken, so that pictures can appear on a word.

steps.name: Images
steps.what: Where the pictures in a scene come from.

steps.name: Clips
steps.what: Where short pieces of video come from.

steps.name: Sharing
steps.what: How other people get to watch the video.

steps.name: Posting
steps.what: How the video gets onto a platform.

services.name: Kokoro
services.about: A voice model that runs on this computer. It is the default voice.

steps: Nothing to set up. The model downloads the first time it is needed.
setup.use: Run "explainroo voices" to see the voices, then set "voice" in video.json.

services.name: Your own recording
services.about: You read the script yourself, and explainroo uses that sound.

steps: Nothing to set up. Record the narration in a quiet room and put the file in assets/.

services.name: ElevenLabs
services.about: A company that turns text into speech. It offers premium and cloned voices.
services.cost: Paid per character on your ElevenLabs account.
services.data_leaves: The narration text goes to ElevenLabs.

steps: Open the API keys page in your account settings.
Make a key that may read voices and make speech, and copy it.
setup.use: Run "explainroo voices --elevenlabs" to see the voices, then set "voice": { "provider": "elevenlabs", "id": "<voice id>" } in video.json.

services.name: Whisper
services.about: A speech model that runs on this computer. It listens to the narration and notes when each word is spoken.

steps: Nothing to set up. The model downloads the first time it is needed.
setup.use: It always runs. Cue a picture on a spoken word with at: 'word' in scenes.js.

services.name: Built-in icons and your own image files
services.about: More than 1,800 icons come with explainroo, and any image you put in assets/ works too.

setup.use: Search the icons with "explainroo icons <word>". Draw them with s.icon, and your own files with s.image.

services.name: OpenRouter images
services.about: A company that gives one account access to many AI models. explainroo uses it to make illustrations.
services.cost: Paid per image on your OpenRouter account, roughly 7 to 13 cents.
services.data_leaves: The prompt and any reference images go to OpenRouter and to the company that runs the image model.

steps: Make an account at openrouter.ai and add some credit.
Open openrouter.ai/keys and make a new key.
setup.use: Make an image with: explainroo image <project> <name> "<what to draw>"

services.name: Your own footage
services.about: Any video file you put in assets/ can play in a scene.

steps: Nothing to set up. Put the video file in assets/.
setup.use: Play it in a scene with s.clip('assets/name.mp4').

services.name: Built-in music
services.about: explainroo makes music on this computer while it renders, and each look has its own style.

setup.use: It is on by default. Set "music" in video.json to pick a style or to turn it off.

services.name: Web player for your own site
services.about: "explainroo export" writes a folder with a player, and you put that folder on your own website.
services.data_leaves: Nothing leaves your computer until you copy the folder to your site.

setup.use: Run "explainroo export <project>" and copy out/player/ to your site.

services.name: Uploading by hand
services.about: You upload the finished MP4 to the platform yourself.
services.data_leaves: Nothing leaves your computer until you upload the file.

setup.use: Run "explainroo render <project>" and upload out/video.mp4. Its .srt file works as captions on YouTube and LinkedIn.
